theorems.name: Submission.dpf_pfc_imrep_pairing_integrable_abs_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U C : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (F : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (B : ℝ), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable F (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier) → (∀ x, x ∉ C → F x = 0) → (∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B) → Integrable (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (F x)) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier) ∧ |∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (F x) ∂μHE[n]| ≤ B * (∫⁻ x in R.carrier ∩ C, (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n]).toReal
